summary.text: Melissa Simpson is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 143 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat John Henkelman.
She is an at-large member of the Sanford Public Schools school board, with a term ending in 2028.

paragraphs.text: Simpson said in a Ballotpedia survey that she moved to southern Maine from Presque Isle nearly 20 years ago and settled in Sanford.
She said her community service began with the PTA and coaching soccer, and that she later joined Strategies for a Stronger Sanford and became vice president of the Legacy foundation.
She described herself as serving her fourth year as an elected School Committee member.

In the survey, Simpson listed affordability, accountability, and open communication and transparency as her key messages, and said she would favor increasing the homestead exemption and reducing regulations.
She named state operations, housing and the economy as her policy interests and cited a real estate background.
